*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]

***[[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] announces that Ukraine has captured two [[North Korea]]n soldiers in healthy condition in [[Kursk Oblast]], [[Russia]], for the first time since North Korea entered the war, as the two previous North Korean prisoners of war died of their injuries shortly following their capture. **[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***The [[Puntland Security Force]] discover a cave used to store food by [[Islamic State|ISIL]] in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains, while killing and capturing insurgent fighters and destroying [[improvised explosive devices]] and hideouts. The security force also took down three [[drone warfare|drones]] armed with explosives as they continue their offensive into [[Bari, Somalia|Bari region]], [[Puntland]]. **[[France]] places the [[Indian Ocean]] island of [[Mayotte]] on red alert due to approaching [[2024–25 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season#Tropical Cyclone Dikeledi|Tropical Cyclone Dikeledi]], roughly one month after the [[French overseas department]] was devastated by [[Cyclone Chido]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/cyclone-battered-mayotte-be-put-red-alert-2025-01-11/ (Reuters)]
